claims.quote: One can conceive it provided in the future with cross-thread telescopic sights, the focussing of which, corrected by some ingenious use of hygroscopic material, might even find the range, and so enable it to be used with assurance up to a mile or more.
claims.description: A future rifle has telescopic sights that find the range automatically, letting it hit targets reliably at a mile.

claims.quote: It will be used either for single shots or to quiver and send a spray of almost simultaneous bullets out of a magazine evenly and certainly, over any small area the rifleman thinks advisable.
claims.description: Future rifles fire either single shots or bursts that spray almost simultaneous bullets over a small area.

claims.quote: It will, just as probably, be slung with its ammunition and equipment upon bicycle wheels, and be the common care of two or more associated soldiers.
claims.description: Future weapons are carried on bicycle wheels and operated by two or more soldiers together.

claims.quote: a single couple of marksmen even, by reason of smokeless powder and carefully chosen cover, might make themselves practically invisible, and capable of surprising, stopping, and destroying a visible enemy in quite considerable numbers who blundered within a mile of them
claims.description: A pair of concealed marksmen using smokeless powder could ambush and destroy many enemies within a mile.

claims.quote: Save for their liability to such attacks, a few hundreds of such men could hold positions of a quite vast extent, and a few thousand might hold a frontier.
claims.description: A few hundred marksmen could hold a vast position, and a few thousand could hold an entire frontier.

claims.quote: The aeronauts, provided with large scale maps of the hostile country, will mark down to the gunners below the precise point upon which to direct their fire
claims.description: Balloon observers will direct long-range guns onto targets many miles away using maps.

claims.quote: Great multitudes of balloons will be the Argus eyes of the entire military organism, stalked eyes with a telephonic nerve in each stalk
claims.description: Many military balloons will serve as observation eyes for the army, each linked by telephone to its commanders.

claims.quote: Few people, I fancy, who know the work of Langley, Lilienthal, Pilcher, Maxim, and Chanute, but will be inclined to believe that long before the year a.d. 2000, and very probably before 1950, a successful aeroplane will have soared and come home safe and sound.
claims.description: A powered, controlled aeroplane will fly successfully and return safely, probably before 1950.

claims.quote: Directly that is accomplished the new invention will be most assuredly applied to war.
claims.description: Once aircraft fly successfully, they will certainly be adapted for military use.

claims.quote: A row of such contractile balloons, hung over a long car which was horizontally expanded into wings, would not only allow that car to rise and fall at will
claims.description: An airship with contractile gas bags and a wing-shaped car can rise, fall, and glide under control.

claims.quote: I incline to imagine there will be a steel prow with a cutting edge at either end of the sort of aerostat I foresee, and conceivably this aerial ram will be the most important weapon of the affair.
claims.description: Future airships will carry steel rams at each end, possibly becoming the decisive aerial weapon.

claims.quote: Quite certainly those flying machines will carry folded parachutes
claims.description: Future flying machines will carry folded parachutes so their crews can escape a falling craft.

claims.quote: Once the command of the air is obtained by one of the contending armies, the war must become a conflict between a seeing host and one that is blind.
claims.description: The army that wins control of the air will see everything while its enemy is blind, deciding the war.

claims.quote: By day the victor's aeroplanes will sweep down upon the apparatus of all sorts in the adversary's rear, and will drop explosives and incendiary matters upon them
claims.description: The air-superior force will bomb the enemy's rear equipment and supplies by day and search for them at night.

claims.quote: ironclad road fighting-machines may perhaps play a considerable part in this
claims.description: Armoured road vehicles may take a significant part in the ground advance.

claims.quote: It will probably be brought about in a civilized country by the seizure of the vital apparatus of the urban regions—the water supply, the generating stations for electricity (which will supply all the heat and warmth of the land), and the chief ways used in food distribution.
claims.description: Conquest will be enforced by seizing a country's city water, electricity generation, and food distribution systems.

claims.quote: I seem to see a light type of ironclad, armoured thickly only over its engines and magazines, murderously equipped, and with a ram
claims.description: Future warships will be lightly armored, fast, and equipped with a ram rather than heavy overall protection.

claims.quote: And then will open a second phase of naval warfare, in which the submarine may play a larger part.
claims.description: After the early stage of a naval war, submarines may take a larger role in sea combat.

claims.quote: The struggle on the high seas between any two naval powers (except, perhaps, the English and American, who have both quite unparalleled opportunities for coaling) will not last more than a week or so.
claims.description: A naval struggle between two major powers will be decided within about a week.
claims.stated_time: not more than a week or so

claims.quote: These guns will be carried on vast mechanical carriages, possibly with wheels of such a size as will enable them to traverse almost all sorts of ground.
claims.description: Artillery will ride on huge mechanical carriages with wheels able to cross nearly any terrain.

claims.quote: a practical realization of socialistic conceptions will quite inevitably be forced upon the fighting State
claims.description: Wartime will force the state to take over industry and resources, realizing socialist ideas.
